decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core practice software with a strong launch signal and continued dedicated presentation, it likely stays above the firm's aspiration level or close enough to justify continued support under existing organisational slack.

The education institute leverages the firm's training and customer relationship resources, and even if results are only moderate, its strategic fit with the installed base makes management likely to tolerate uncertainty and keep it.

Because the remote support tool appears less differentiated, only lightly promoted, and easily substitutable within the firm's normal support activities, management would likely judge it below aspiration as a standalone offer and reallocate resources elsewhere.

Practice analytics fits the firm's direction toward digital and efficient practice management, so with clear relatedness to the core business management would likely continue it despite limited early evidence.

A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and should strengthen sales of the broader product range, making it a natural product to retain in a growing firm with broad offerings.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the firm's core software business and was only briefly mentioned, so under bounded rationality and problemistic search it is the clearest candidate to exit when compared with stronger core-adjacent uses of resources.
